question: At the 2025 World Bank Land Conference, which country was honoured as a Country Champion in recognition of its transformative work in rural land governance?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **India** was honoured as a **Country Champion** at the **2025 World Bank Land Conference** for its transformative efforts in **rural land governance**. This recognition highlights India's significant progress in implementing land reforms and improving land administration systems.
 
• The award acknowledges India's use of **digital technologies** and innovative approaches to enhance **transparency, efficiency, and accessibility** in rural land records management.
 
• India's flagship program, **Digital India Land Records Modernization Programme (DILRMP)**, played a pivotal role in achieving this milestone. The program aims to digitize land records, reduce disputes, and ensure land ownership transparency.
 
• India has also focused on empowering rural communities by providing secure land tenure to marginalized groups, including women and tribal populations, under initiatives such as the **Forest Rights Act, 2006**.
 
• The recognition underscores India's commitment to achieving **Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)**, particularly Goal 1 (No Poverty) and Goal 15 (Life on Land), through effective rural land governance strategies.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Digital India Land Records Modernization Programme (DILRMP):**

 
 
• Launched in **2008**, this program aims to digitize and modernize land records to enhance transparency and minimize land disputes.
 
• It focuses on integrating **spatial and non-spatial data**, providing a unified land information system accessible to stakeholders.
 
• DILRMP promotes the use of **GIS (Geographical Information System)** and **remote sensing technologies** for accurate land mapping.
 
 
 
• **Forest Rights Act, 2006:**
 
 
• This landmark legislation recognizes the rights of forest-dwelling communities over land and resources, ensuring their socio-economic empowerment.
 
• It aims to correct historical injustices faced by tribal populations and other traditional forest dwellers.
 
 
 
• **World Bank Land Conference:**
 
 
• An international platform where countries share best practices, policies, and innovations in land governance and administration.
 
• The conference focuses on achieving equitable land access and security to support sustainable development worldwide.
 
 
 
• **Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs):**
 
 
• Adopted by the United Nations in 2015, the SDGs aim to address global challenges like poverty, inequality, and environmental degradation by 2030.
 
• India's efforts in rural land governance contribute to achieving SDG Goal 1 (**No Poverty**) by reducing land disputes and ensuring secure land tenure.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **India's Achievements in Rural Land Governance:**

 
 
• The use of **e-governance platforms** like the **Bhoomi Project** in Karnataka and **Bhulekh** in other states has streamlined land record management.
 
• India has effectively utilized satellite imagery and geospatial data for land surveys and mapping under programs like **SVAMITVA (Survey of Villages and Mapping with Improvised Technology in Village Areas)**.
 
• Special initiatives to address the needs of vulnerable groups, such as women and tribal populations, have contributed to inclusive land governance.
 
 
 
• **Global Context:**
 
 
• According to the **World Bank's Ease of Doing Business Report**, land administration efficiency is crucial for fostering economic growth and investment.
 
• Countries around the world are adopting digital technologies to modernize land records and address issues like fraudulent transactions and land disputes.
